newsitem.title: USA: Republicans tell Yeltsin of concern over murder.
newsitem.headline: Republicans tell Yeltsin of concern over murder.

text.p: House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich and other Republicans asked Russian President Boris Yeltsin on Monday for information on the murder of an American businessmen in Moscow.
In a letter, the Republican Congressmen asked Yeltsin to give maximum resources to solving the machine-gun murder of Paul Tatum on the steps leading to a Moscow subway station on Nov. 3.

The Republican leaders said their decisions on aid to Russia and contributions to international financial institutions providing funds to the Russian government would be shaped by progress in addressing crime and corruption.
They said the atmosphere of unrestrained crime undermined the willingness of American businesses to increase trade, investments and joint ventures in Russia.

"Because of our serious interest in this matter, we ask further that you undertake to obtain the assistance of the appropriate Russian authorities in keeping the U.S. Congress fully and continuously apprised of the progress of your investigation into Mr. Tatum's murder," the letter said.
